events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your ultimate festival anthem?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', who passed away in 1977 and would have been 91 today.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled legacy of Elvis Presley. His music still moves generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996 and would have been 55 today.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years since the passing of a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's lyrics continue to resonate. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died in London in 1970 at the age of 27 and would have been 84 today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Jimi Hendrix, a true trailblazer whose guitar mastery changed music forever. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting have powered The Pretenders for decades.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo anthem from him?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless solo album 'Imagine' in 1971, featuring the iconic title track.

angles.name: Imagine The Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that continues to inspire hope and peace around the world.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple revolutionised portable music forever with the release of the first iPod in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs could you fit on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, who is your favourite Bond and what's your top 007 film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary co-founder of The Beatles, John Lennon, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, what's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered the iconic 'White Album'. So many classics packed into one double LP. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song?
